test_date_datetime: test the polars pl.date and pl.datetime functions with column references for year, month, day, hour
test_date_invalid_component: test that pl.date raises ComputeError for invalid date components like month 13 or day 32
test_datetime_invalid_date_component: test that pl.datetime raises ComputeError for invalid date components when constructing datetimes
test_datetime_invalid_time_component: test that pl.datetime raises ComputeError for invalid time components like hour 25 or minute 60
test_datetime_time_unit: test that pl.datetime accepts time_unit parameter with ms, us, or ns resolution
test_datetime_time_zone: test that pl.datetime accepts time_zone parameter with None, UTC, or IANA timezone names
test_datetime_ambiguous_time_zone: test that pl.datetime raises ComputeError for ambiguous wall-clock times during DST transitions
test_datetime_ambiguous_time_zone_earlie: test that pl.datetime resolves ambiguous DST times using the ambiguous parameter
test_datetime_wildcard_expansion: test that pl.datetime supports pl.all() wildcard expansion for year, month, day arguments
test_datetime_invalid_time_zone: test that pl.datetime raises ComputeError for unrecognized timezone strings
test_datetime_from_empty_column: test that pl.datetime handles empty dataframes without raising errors
